name: ecompilot-agent
description: Read-only ERPNext business analysis and explicitly authorized outbound Feishu reports.

displayName.zh: EcomPilot AI｜跨境电商 ERP 智能经营助手

profession.zh: 跨境电商经营分析助手

displayDescription.en: Queries real ERPNext orders and inventory, checks business exceptions, and sends reports through the existing Feishu connection only when authorized.
displayDescription.zh: 读取真实ERP订单与库存，核查待办及低库存风险，生成中文经营日报，并按明确授权向飞书发送。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Generate a business brief from all current demo ERP data. Show it only; do not send.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 读取全部演示数据，生成经营简报，先展示，不发送飞书。

quickPrompts.en: Generate a business brief from all current demo ERP data. Show it only; do not send.
quickPrompts.zh: 读取全部演示数据，生成经营简报，先展示，不发送飞书。

quickPrompts.en: Generate today's business report using a low-stock threshold of 20. Do not send.
quickPrompts.zh: 生成今日经营日报，低库存阈值20件，先不发送。

quickPrompts.en: Generate an all-demo report using threshold 60; show it and wait for recipient confirmation before sending.
quickPrompts.zh: 读取全部演示数据，库存预警阈值60件；先展示报告，确认接收人后再发送飞书。
